raw.description: 自身登场之后，奇数次的攻击技能命中后附加自身防御值50%的百分比伤害，偶数次的攻击技能命中后附加自身特防值50%的百分比伤害|每场战斗自身首次受到致死伤害时保留1点体力，防御值与特防值降低50%并主动恢复等量体力|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]自身[color=#57c975]登场[/color][color=#52a5f2]之后[/color]，奇数次的[color=#57c975]攻击技能命中后[/color]附加自身防御值50%的百分比伤害，偶数次的[color=#57c975]攻击技能命中后[/color]附加自身特防值50%的[color=#52a5f2]百分比伤害[/color]|[sprite name=dot4]每场战斗自身[color=#52a5f2]首次[/color]受到[color=#52a5f2]致死伤害[/color]时[color=#52a5f2]保留[/color]1点体力，防御值与特防值降低50%并[color=#52a5f2]主动恢复[/color]等量体力

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 最新用户确认致死保护后当前有效面板减半向上取整并按两项实际减少量回复，能力等级不参与；同步及替换面板均覆盖。
review.singleBehavior: 成功攻击命中奇偶交替按防御/特防面板50%附粉，正零负能力等级基数一致；MISS、整招无效、控制及属性招不计，已命中零红和附粉免疫仍计；首次正致死伤害保1的HP/完整结算伤害前缀已验证，随后未核实的降低与回血明确报错，回合不提交。

success.name: 4857真实2044奇偶命中分别按防御和特防面板50%附粉，能力等级正零负基数均不变
success.assertion: for(const level of[-6,0,6]){const s=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{def:300,spd:500}});s.fighters[0].stages.def=level;s.fighters[0].stages.spd=level;turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),150);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044.hits,1);turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),250);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044.hits,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,level);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spd,level);}

success.name: 4857真实2044未命中、整招无效、无法行动与属性招不计攻击命中；零红与附粉免疫仍计次
4857真实2044首次致死保1前缀保留完整伤害与实际HP损失，后续降低回血按已答提交；已消费不再次保命
success.assertion:
for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent','true']){const s=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,hp:200,bStats:{atk:9999}});let seen=false;observe((event,c)=>{if(event==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1&&type!=='attack')c.hurt(c.t,500,'致死测试',type);if(event==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.hp,1);assert.equal(c.hpLoss,199);assert.ok(c.settledDamage>=200);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.phalanx2044.survivalUsed,true);seen=true;}},()=>turn(s,10780,type==='attack'?10127:20117),true);assert.equal(seen,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,301,'实际损失199后保1，再按两防实际减少300回复');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.def,150);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spd,150);}
 const used=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,bStats:{atk:9999}});used.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044={hits:0,survivalUsed:true,pendingSurvival:false};turn(used,10780,10127);assert.equal(used.fighters[0].hp,0);const zero=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,hp:200});timer(zero,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10780,10127);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044.survivalUsed,false);assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);

success.name: 4857真实2044与1768转盾先结算，原本致死攻击归零不会错误消耗首次致死资源
success.assertion: const a=make({move:29235,soul:true,hp:100,bStats:{atk:9999}});turn(a,29235,10127);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,100);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].suitState.shield,300);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044?.survivalUsed??false,false);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044?.pendingSurvival??false,false);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(29235)],4);

success.name: 4857已答2044：奇数两防半值向上取整，回复按实际减少量，正零负等级不改变面板基数，先扣损失再回复
success.assertion: for(const stage of [-6,0,6]){const s=make({move,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{def:401,spd:403}});s.fighters[0].stages.def=stage;s.fighters[0].stages.spd=stage;hit(s);const a=s.fighters[0],e=a.soulState.phalanx2044.survivalEvents[0];assert.equal(a.stats.def,201);assert.equal(a.stats.spd,202);assert.equal(a.stages.def,stage);assert.equal(a.stages.spd,stage);assert.equal(e.total,401);assert.equal(e.hpBefore,1);assert.equal(e.restored,401);assert.equal(a.hp,402);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed').settledDamage,1000);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed').hpLoss,99);}

success.name: 4857已答2044：实际攻击伤害路径也在保1后减两防回复，原本1HP零HP损失仍触发一次
success.assertion:
const red=make({move,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{def:301,spd:303},bStats:{atk:9999}});turn(red,move,10127);assert.ok(sum(red,'attack',1)>100);assert.equal(red.fighters[0].hp,302);assert.equal(red.fighters[0].stats.def,151);assert.equal(red.fighters[0].stats.spd,152);
 const one=make({move,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});hit(one);assert.equal(one.fighters[0].hp,301);assert.equal(one.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed').hpLoss,0);assert.equal(one.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed').settledDamage,1000);assert.equal(one.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044.survivalEvents.length,1);

success.name: 4857已答2044：降低同步或替换后的面板，不改基础或对手面板，回复仍取两项实际减少之和
success.assertion: for(const mode of ['sync','preset']){const s=make({move,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,aStats:{def:201,spd:203},bStats:{def:777,spd:779}});if(mode==='sync'){timer(s,0,'面板同步:def',{sourceSide:1});timer(s,0,'面板同步:spd',{sourceSide:1});}else timer(s,0,'面板数值设定',{values:{def:501,spd:503}});hit(s);const a=s.fighters[0],expected=mode==='sync'?[389,390,777]:[251,252,501];assert.equal(E.panelStat(a,'def'),expected[0]);assert.equal(E.panelStat(a,'spd'),expected[1]);assert.equal(a.stats.def,201);assert.equal(a.stats.spd,203);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.def,777);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.spd,779);assert.equal(a.hp,1+expected[2]);assert.equal(a.soulState.phalanx2044.survivalEvents[0].total,expected[2]);}

success.name: 4857/4与5全部重复能力实例、14与15真实概率与免疫，33清强遵守保护，29定额150固伤
4857/48四回合免异与47免弱，164受击冻伤、191反弹不耗免异次数，1014严格高于半血双强
success.assertion: const a=make(row(48));turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);},()=>turn(a,38218));const b=make(row(47));turn(b);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}},()=>turn(b,38218));const c=make(row(164));turn(c,24584,10127);assert.ok(c.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']);const d=make(row(191));d.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(d));for(const [hp,want]of[[4500,1],[4501,2]]){const s=make({...row(1014),hp});turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],want);}

success.name: 4857/453已命中零红仍清强附害怕，次数免异只挡害怕不回滚清强，强化保护使清强失败不附害怕
success.assertion: const a=make({move:38216,index:0});a.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a),0);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);const b=make({move:38216,index:0});b.fighters[1].stages.def=2;b.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);const c=make({move:38216,index:0});c.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(c,1,'强化保护');turn(c);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].stages.def,2);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);

success.name: 4857/4与5全部重复能力实例、14与15真实概率与免疫，33清强遵守保护，29定额150固伤
4857/48四回合免异与47免弱，164受击冻伤、191反弹不耗免异次数，1014严格高于半血双强
success.assertion: const a=make(row(48));turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);},()=>turn(a,38218));const b=make(row(47));turn(b);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}},()=>turn(b,38218));const c=make(row(164));turn(c,24584,10127);assert.ok(c.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']);const d=make(row(191));d.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(d));for(const [hp,want]of[[4500,1],[4501,2]]){const s=make({...row(1014),hp});turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],want);}

success.name: 4857/573仅清强吸强触发两回合冻伤、1701先手50%独立整招抽样后手100%，伤害翻倍不当异常执行
success.assertion:
for(const op of['clear','steal','reverse']){const a=make(row(573));turn(a);a.fighters[0].stages.def=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(op==='clear')c.clearBoost(c.t);else if(op==='steal')c.steal(c.a,c.t,'真实吸强');else c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{def:-2},'reverse');}},()=>turn(a,38218));assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤'],op!=='reverse');if(op!=='reverse')assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤'],3);}
 const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++)for(const late of[false,true]){const a=make({...row(1701),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0,aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});if(!late)timer(a,0,'id984',{amount:2});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(a));assert.ok([1,2].includes(c.modifier));if(late)assert.equal(c.modifier,2);else seen.add(c.modifier);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);

 for(const [hp,n]of[[1000,3000],[8990,10],[9000,0]]){const b=make({...row(532),hp});turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,hp+n);assert.equal(sum(b,'percent'),n);}const ban=make({...row(532),hp:1000});timer(ban,0,'技能禁疗');turn(ban);assert.equal(ban.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(sum(ban,'percent'),0);

success.name: 4857/573仅清强吸强触发两回合冻伤、1701先手50%独立整招抽样后手100%，伤害翻倍不当异常执行
success.assertion:
for(const op of['clear','steal','reverse']){const a=make(row(573));turn(a);a.fighters[0].stages.def=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(op==='clear')c.clearBoost(c.t);else if(op==='steal')c.steal(c.a,c.t,'真实吸强');else c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{def:-2},'reverse');}},()=>turn(a,38218));assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤'],op!=='reverse');if(op!=='reverse')assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤'],3);}
 const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++)for(const late of[false,true]){const a=make({...row(1701),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0,aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});if(!late)timer(a,0,'id984',{amount:2});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(a));assert.ok([1,2].includes(c.modifier));if(late)assert.equal(c.modifier,2);else seen.add(c.modifier);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);

success.name: 4857/1179清回合成功授下两次50%红增，147后手冰封且免疫失败不补，747负阶段先制1
success.assertion:
const a=make(row(1179)),base=make({move:38217,index:-1});for(const s of[a,base]){s.moveDefinitions[key(38218)].operations=[];turn(s);}base.fighters[1].effects={};assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,2);for(const want of[1.5,1.5,1]){for(const s of[a,base]){s.rng=0x9e3779b9;turn(s,38218);}assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)-sum(base)*want)<=1);}const no=make(row(1179));timer(no,1,'protect');no.moveDefinitions[key(38218)].operations=[];turn(no);let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(no,38218));assert.equal(c.modifier,1);
 const late=make(row(147));turn(late);assert.ok(late.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);const first=make(row(147));timer(first,0,'id984',{amount:2});turn(first);assert.equal(first.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],undefined);const immune=make(row(147));immune.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],undefined);for(const negative of[false,true]){const b=make(row(747));if(negative)b.fighters[0].stages.def=-1;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,negative?1:0);}
